entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: Panther warrior planeswalker of Urborg, one of the Nine Titans, who became a protective Avatar of Urborg.

entities.name: Nine Titans
entities.description: Planeswalkers Urza gathered to fight Phyrexia.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: Planeswalker killed by Urza; Windgrace kept his heart.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: Marked by Windgrace to control him.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Urged Windgrace to seal the time rift.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Urged Windgrace to seal the time rift.

entities.name: Aryel
entities.description: Trained with panther-folk, bearing Windgrace's legacy.

entities.name: Time Spiral crisis
entities.description: Crisis during which Windgrace died sealing a rift.

events.summary: After Urza kills Taysir, Windgrace takes Taysir's heart and puts it next to his own.
events.quote: Windgrace took the fallen planeswalker's heart and put it next to his own

events.summary: Windgrace and the four remaining titans manually activate the soul bombs, gutting the plane.
events.quote: manually activating the soul bombs, gutting the plane completely

events.summary: Windgrace attempts to seal the time rift in Urborg; it drains his life and he vanishes with it.
events.quote: As the rift vanished from existence, so too did Lord Windgrace.

events.summary: Before facing the rift he fuses his spirit to Urborg to watch over it.
events.quote: he performed a spell to fuse his spirit to Urborg and watch over it

relations.quote: He was one of the Nine Titans that Urza gathered to fight Phyrexia
When Urza went mad and killed Taysir
